events.evidence: Git diff changes inference update and conformance vectors; pre-October-6 commit snapshots declare BRAID 1.0. Dirty execution version remains uncertain.

Git diff adds transitive/shared parent ancestry and explicit equivalence/inference corrections. Tied diagnostic core hashes match this source before its later commit; timestamp or parent revision alone cannot attribute fixes to paid runs.

Committed selector keeps every tied maximum claim eligible and ranks by relevance times reliability. Saved diagnostic reports two recovered cases relative to smoke; paid tied-maxima selections corroborate those changes.
Existing conflict-coverage/selective reports are offline selection-only analyses with no new generated answers, tokens, cost, or paid timing trials; none replace these publication measurements.

tied_diagnostic.attribution_limit: Equal selected evidence is a behavioral check, not identical execution code or interchangeable answer, timing, usage and cost measurements

lineage_audit.uncertainty: Every manifested run records a dirty checkout. Broad implementation fingerprints prove byte-set differences, not which algorithm or selector component changed. Exact executed source versions are null unless independently preserved; committed snapshots and behavioral matches are separate evidence.
